sentences.text:
18.09.2023 C.R.M. (A) 3726 of 2023
 Ml. 119
Court No. 29
 Nkb
 In Re: - An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of

the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Tehatta
 Police Station Case No. 553 of 2023 dated 15.07.2023 under
Sections 376/417 of the Indian Penal Code.

And
 In the matter of: Shibam Pramanick
 ....petitioner.
 Ms. Sumanta Das
 ...for the petitioner.

Mr. B. B. Imam  Mr. R. Jana  ...for the State.
 1.
Heard learned Counsel for the parties.
2. It is a case of consensual physical relationship between two majors.
The relationship is alleged to have been established on the basis of promise of the petitioner to marry the victim.
It is a question of fact as to whether such promise by the petitioner was for the purpose of cheating from the very outset.
Such question should be left to be decided by the trial court.

3. Regard being had to such facts and submissions, factum of permanent residence of the petitioner,
nature of allegation and substantial progress in investigation, it is directed that the petitioner shall be released on bail by the Arresting Officer in the event of his arrest in the aforesaid P.S. case on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case including the condition that :
i) the petitioner is directed to appear before the IO once in a week on the day and time fixed by the IO for the purpose of investigation till submission of Final Form.
4. Accordingly, the prayer for the anticipatory bail is allowed.
5. The application being CRM (A) 3726 of 2023 is disposed of.

(Chitta Ranjan Dash, J.) (Partha Sarathi Sen, J.)
